label: Tidewake lt2 regrade GPU Medium
brief: Six fixed views of a water-chapter coast (First Shore at noon, evening and night; a dune at noon and dawn; a waterfall cliff up close) with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether the biome reads as the key art's open water chapter, with each time of day lit as its own mood.
defects: Evening and dawn are graded like midday (same light and colour, only the sky changes)
The sea meets the sky on a razor seam with no haze or falloff into distance
The night beach is flat ambient: nothing casts a shadow
